verdict.rationale: Smithery once documented a Vercel AI SDK integration, which handled OAuth, token refresh and aggregation of tools across servers on top of its hosted Connect service. However, Smithery's own shutdown notice says Connect and its SDKs stopped working on 2026-10-31, and the docs tree was removed. No adapters for LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs were ever evidenced, so no working, documented framework adapter is delivered today.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the platform's tools into major agent frameworks and SDKs (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs) with documented adapters
